location_exception_reason: PEB fabrication is a nationwide industrial service; location is a logistics/delivery detail, not a buyer decision factor. GI-tagged or regional-origin exemptions do not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, EPC) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. The product is a PEB structure regardless of seller classification.
